lines.text: Two faces, web and Mac, share one server and one voice.
Vision turns frames into observations; the Conductor streams cues back.
Frames are masked in the browser; each change becomes one typed observation.
She never interrupts typing or talking; she prepares early and asks at the pause.
Live, on the real product: Show.
What determines whether you put customer 07’s delivery address and time window in the email text or leave them in the attachment?
Reflect: when Show ends, the Work Map is built from the session.
After one spoken correction, the expert confirms the map.
Pass it on, a new case.
The expert would stop here before sending and ask: why do you think this draft is ready to send?
The new hire fixes it. Clipa warns; she never clicks.
Honest limits: synthetic data, inputs posted as text, and slow vision on Codex.
Next: a company memory that asks only about what changed.
